item.title: A Repeatable Microsoft 365 Offboarding Script with Graph PowerShell
item.description:
Overview

Offboarding is one of those tasks that’s simple on paper and easy to get subtly wrong in practice. Miss a step and you end up with a departed user who still has an active session token, a mailbox nobody can read, or a license you’re paying for months later.

Between employees and a steady rotation of contractors, I was offboarding people often enough that a checklist in my head wasn’t good enough. This post walks through the script I use now. It takes a UPN and runs the whole sequence the same way every time.

item.title: Moving 70 Mailboxes from Google Workspace to Exchange Online Without Losing a Message
item.description:
Overview

Email is the one system nobody notices until it stops working. When we moved a 70-person company from Google Workspace to Exchange Online, the goal wasn’t just “move the mail.” It was to move the mail without anyone missing a message, a calendar invite, or an automated workflow that quietly depended on a Gmail inbox.

This post is the checklist I wish I’d had at the start. It’s written for small IT teams (often a team of one) doing a cutover without a migration partner.
